Subgroup analyses of survival To evaluate the consistency of the BMI effect across various patient demographics and clinical features, subgroup analyses were conducted for both PFS ( Figure 3 ) and OS ( Figure 4 ). The PFS subgroup analysis ( Figure 3 ) demonstrated that the detrimental effect of low BMI was particularly pronounced in several subgroups.
